title: Project site: configs, stats and a setup guide
body: This site is up as a local preview. Build a config with every option the browser build has, take it to the game as a file or a launch link, and open your save backup on the Stats page to see your profiles, records, medals and unlocks. Your files never leave your browser.
The builder that turns your own disc into the local game is being written now; the setup guide describes how it will work.

title: Four players, 60 fps
body: Split screen for up to four players runs at 60 fps on Windows, and a single race holds 60 fps in Edge. A stall in the browser build between the intro and the title screen is fixed.

title: Free Ride, saves and higher resolutions
body: Free Ride drops you straight into an endless freestyle session in the stadium. Saves now stay in the browser and can be exported as a zip that the Windows build also reads. The game can render at up to 8x its original resolution, with MSAA and a 16:9 mode.

title: Drawn on the GPU
body: The game's graphics no longer go through a software rasteriser: its draw calls are recorded as frame packets and drawn on the GPU, which took races from a few frames per second to a steady 60.

title: It boots
body: The retail Xbox game, recompiled to C, reached its menus and its first race on Windows.
